d:
Before we ask the world for answers, it helps to become quiet enough to hear our own.
Your heart has been gathering wisdom long before your mind learned to doubt it. The challenge isn’t that we don’t know our path. It’s that life is loud enough to make us forget.
Meditation has taught me that clarity rarely arrives through more thinking. It appears in the spaces between thoughts. In the moments when I stop trying to force life into a direction and simply listen.
Trust yourself. Not because you are always right, but because your deepest truth is found within, not in the noise around you.
